name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira discovered his passion for motorsport while working as a journalist covering local rally events in Portugal. He quickly realized his talent lay not just in reporting the news, but in shaping it. He transitioned into PR, honing his skills at smaller racing teams before landing a coveted role at Red Bull Racing. Ricardo believes in proactive communication, building strong relationships with media outlets and crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike.

His calm demeanor and ability to think on his feet make him invaluable during high-pressure situations. He's known for his dedication to accuracy and his commitment to representing the team in the best possible light. Ricardo's fluency in several languages also makes him a strong asset in international communications.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build, often seen with a friendly, approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Portuguese coffee every morning.
